labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Yaak is a desktop API client for organizing and executing REST, GraphQL, and gRPC requests.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Yaak

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG YAAK_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

ENV \
  HOME="/config" \
  TITLE="Yaak" \
  NO_GAMEPAD=true \
  PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/yaak-icon.png && \
  echo "**** install yaak ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  if [ -z ${YAAK_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    YAAK_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET https://api.github.com/repos/mountain-loop/yaak/releases \
      | jq -r '.[] | select(.prerelease != true) | select(.tag_name | contains("yaak-cli") | not) | .tag_name' \
      | sort -rV | head -1); \
  fi && \
  YAAK_URL=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/mountain-loop/yaak/releases/tags/${YAAK_RELEASE}" | jq -r '.assets[].browser_download_url' \
    | grep -v "cef" | grep "amd64" | grep ".deb$") && \
  curl -fo \
    /tmp/yaak.deb -L \
    "${YAAK_URL}" && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    /tmp/yaak.deb && \
  ln -s \
    /usr/bin/yaak-app-client \
    /usr/bin/yaak-app && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get clean && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

notes.upstream:
![Yaak 2026.9.0](https://yaak.app/changelog-og/2026.9.0/banner.png?v=3) The [changelog for 2026.9.0](https://yaak.app/changelog/2026.9.0) has the full write-up, with screenshots of the headline features. Here's everything that changed. ### 🎁 New - 📦 Import from Bruno ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/import-from-bruno)) - Import several files, folders, and URLs in one batch ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/support-for-importing-zip-or-multiple-files-and-only-allow-importable-file-forma)) ### 💄 Improved - 📂 Multi-file import ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/redesigned-import-data-dialog)) - Import multiple collections into one existing workspace ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/import-multiple-files-to-single-workspace)) - Show gRPC proto files and import folders as a file list ([#706](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/706), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/grpc-proto-file-picker-uses-the-shared-file-list)) - Write template string arguments in plain quotes instead of base64 ([#708](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/708)) - Convert Insomnia timestamp, hash, base64, cookie, and prompt tags on import ([#712](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/712), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/convert-the-remaining-insomnia-tags-to-native-yaak-functions-on-import)) ### 🛠️ Fixed - Keep sidebar items in place when editing items with equal sort priorities ([#705](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/705)) - Open the imported workspace after a deep-link import - 🧩 Better Insomnia imports ([#693](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/693)) - Keep template tags intact when a quoted argument contains ]} ([#710](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/710)) - Open the environment editor faster when it has many variables ([#713](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/713), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/environment-dialog-takes-about-half-a-second-to-open-on-large-workspaces)) - Select new sub-environments in the editor and keep disabled rows through bulk edit ([#714](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/714)) - Show an error instead of deleting requests when a sync file can't be read ([#725](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/725)) - Fix PDF previews on older versions of macOS ([#730](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/730), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/view-pdf-bug)) - Ignore leading and trailing spaces in request URLs ([#724](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/724)) - Return attribute and text values from XPath queries ([#723](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/723))
